commit.message:
chore(models): mirror DL weights to Hugging Face (CORS)

Swap the registry weight URLs from OSF to the CORS-enabled Hugging Face model
repo qsmxt/qsm-onnx-weights (resolve/main). Identical files (sha256/bytes
unchanged). OSF sends no Access-Control-Allow-Origin, so the in-browser (WASM)
build can't fetch from it; HF serves Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *. Native
ureq downloads follow the resolve→CDN redirect and still sha256-verify.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
